hints.content:
This is the definition for a unit-fraction exponent:

$x^{^{\scriptsize\dfrac1n}}=\sqrt[n]{x}$

[[☃ explanation 1]]

options.explanation:
By definition, $(\sqrt[n]{x})^n=x^1$ where $n$ is an integer greater than $1$. The power property of exponents tells us that $(x^a)^b=x^{a\cdot b}$.

$\begin{align}
(\sqrt[n]{x})^n&=x^\purpleD{1}\\\\
(\sqrt[n]{x})^n&=x^{\left(\purpleD{\frac{1}{n}\cdot n}\right)}\\\\
(\maroonE{\sqrt[n]{x}})^n&=\left(\maroonE{x^{\frac{1}{n}}}\right)^n&\text{Power property}\\\\
\maroonE{\sqrt[n]{x}} &=\maroonE{x^{\frac{1}{n}}}
\end{align}$
